brief.product_or_service: A weeknight meal-planning app for busy households
brief.campaign_goal: Encourage new users to start a free trial
brief.target_audience: Busy adults and families who want practical dinner ideas with less daily planning
brief.key_message: Build a flexible weekly meal plan from quick recipes, with options to adapt meals to household preferences
required_disclosures: The free trial is available to new accounts. A paid subscription begins after the trial unless canceled.

creative.headline: Make weeknight dinners feel easier
creative.primary_text: A little planning can make the end of the day feel lighter. Find quick dinner ideas, shape a weekly meal plan around your household, and spend less time wondering what’s for dinner. Start your free trial and plan your next week.
creative.description: Flexible meal planning and quick recipe ideas in one place.
